benches.name: dgb01_broken_prof
benches.purpose: DGB0: dgb_01 census with the broken bridges (story -28), 13 counts, prof window 2.

log_metrics.name: ndc_model
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ ndc model ([0-9.]+) spr

log_metrics.name: ndc_ent
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ ndc model [0-9.]+ spr [0-9.]+ ent ([0-9.]+) call

log_metrics.name: pipe_draws
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ pipe fr \d+ draws (\d+) kick

log_metrics.name: nd_dr
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ nd [0-9.]+ lg [0-9.]+ dr (\d+) tc

log_metrics.name: nd_tri
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ nd [0-9.]+ lg [0-9.]+ dr \d+ tc \d+ tw \d+ tri (\d+) leg

log_metrics.name: nd_leg
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ nd .*? tri \d+ leg (\d+) gb

log_metrics.name: sx_m
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ stepx norm n \d+ g \d+ p \d+ d \d+ r \d+ s \d+ t \d+ m (\d+) a

log_metrics.name: sx_t
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ stepx norm n \d+ g \d+ p \d+ d \d+ r \d+ s \d+ t (\d+) m

log_metrics.name: cls_rec
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ cls rec ([0-9.]+) ent

log_metrics.name: cls_sub
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ cls rec .*? sub ([0-9.]+) kick

log_metrics.name: c0r_hit
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ c0r key [0-9.]+ mtx [0-9.]+ hit ([0-9.]+)

log_metrics.name: c1d_rmdl
log_metrics.regex: prof f\d+ w\d+ c1d rmdl ([0-9.]+) rent

log_metrics.name: kc_walk
log_metrics.regex: kcen f\d+ steps 300 kcopy \d+ kwalk (\d+)
